Leah (Finance): Batch run batch_20260401_09 produced duplicate invoices for a small set of customers; several invoices are missing reserved capacity credit lines.

Mateo (Billing Eng): Which batch and sample invoice id? I'll pull generator logs.

Leah (Finance): batch_20260401_09. Example acct 99801: invoices INV-99801-20260401 and INV-99801-20260401-dup were both issued. The dup is missing negative reserved-credit rows so totals differ.

BillingBot: [system] invoice_generator v2.17 job_20260401_09_3 WARNING duplicate_invoice_detected acct=99801 reason=credit_shard_mismatch

Mateo (Billing Eng): That reason suggests reserved-credit rows were sharded separately during normalization and didn't merge with usage rows during aggregation. Might be from the recent negative-row normalization change.

Jun (RevOps): Support already has two tickets for this. Recommend we pause auto-issue when reason=credit_shard_mismatch and run a batch scan.

Leah (Finance): Approve void + credit memo + reissue for affected accounts in this batch. Net effect expected to be zero. Please include a customer-facing note on the reissued invoice.

Sara (Acct Mgr): I'll draft the customer note template: brief apology, explanation of duplicate generation, confirmation of net-zero impact, and new invoice ID.

Mateo (Billing Eng): Plan: 1) run billing_scan --batch batch_20260401_09 --filter credit_shard_mismatch, 2) dry-run recombine and regen invoices, 3) create credit memos for dup invoices and mark them void, 4) emit reissued invoices with note "reissued due to credit_shard_mismatch". Filing ticket BIL-9012 to gate auto-issue on this reason.

BillingBot: [system] ticket created: BIL-9012 (credit_shard_mismatch auto-issue guard).

Mateo (Billing Eng): Dry-run found 4 affected accounts including 99801. Applying fixes after approvals. Created credit memo CM-99801-20260401 and reissued INV-99801-20260401-re1. Marked INV-99801-20260401-dup as void. Uploading reconciliation CSV to s3.

Leah (Finance): Thanks — attach recon CSV and affected list here and add postmortem to BIL-9012 with remediation: hold-on-credit_shard_mismatch + atomic normalization for negative rows. Close once report and postmortem are in.
